title: BatMIL: Geometry-Embedding State Space Model for Whole-Slide Image Representation
abstract: arXiv:2605.05164v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate analysis of histopathological images is critical for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. Whole-slide images (WSIs), which digitize tissue specimens at gigapixel resolution, are fundamental to this process but require aggregating thousands of patches for slide-level predictions. Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) tackles this challenge with a two-stage paradigm, decoupling tile-level embedding and slide-level prediction. However, most existing methods implicitly embed patch representations in homogeneous Euclidean spaces, overlooking the hierarchical organization and regional heterogeneity of pathological tissues. This limits current models' ability to capture global tissue architecture and fine-grained cellular morphology. translated_title: BatMIL：面向全切片图像表示的几何嵌入状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 对组织病理学图像的准确分析对于疾病诊断和治疗规划至关重要。全切片图像（WSI）以十亿像素分辨率对组织标本进行数字化，是这一过程的基础，但需要聚合数千个图像块才能进行切片级预测。多示例学习（MIL）采用两阶段范式来应对这一挑战，将瓦片级嵌入与切片级预测解耦。然而，大多数现有方法隐式地将图像块表示嵌入到同质的欧几里得空间中，忽视了病理组织的层次化结构和区域异质性。这限制了现有模型捕捉全局组织架构和细粒度细胞形态的能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了一种混合双曲-欧几里得表示方法，将WSI特征嵌入到双重几何空间中，从而实现对层次化组织结构的互补建模……
tldr: 提出BatMIL，一种将WSI特征嵌入双曲与欧几里得双重几何空间的几何嵌入状态空间模型，通过互补建模病理组织的层次化结构与区域异质性，提升全切片图像分析对全局组织架构和细粒度细胞形态的捕捉能力。
en_tdlr: BatMIL is a geometry-embedding state space model that embeds WSI features in hybrid hyperbolic-Euclidean dual geometric spaces, enabling complementary modeling of hierarchical tissue organization and regional heterogeneity to better capture global tissue architecture and fine-grained cellular morphology in whole-slide image analysis.
